name: nnMIL
requirements_review: Literal SimpleMIL including full-dimension randperm and ddof1 uncertainty; native adaptive16..48batch/100epoch/10patience/bfloat16/AdamW/two-group/post-update cosine recipe. Four explicit AUC/BACC/F1/Kappa classification selectors, original workers4 and native sampler replay for exact recovery. TRAIN-only feature/label planning is a disclosed repair; TEST remains locked. Source/wheel/full native classification gates, separate survival/regression and current release gates remain pending. No original source redistribution without verified terms.

execution_profiles.recipe: classification recipe: train-only bag-size planning, balanced batches, feature subspaces, masked padding and probability ensemble
native SimpleMIL/AdamW/bfloat16/100epoch maximum/auc early stop; original adaptive plan restricted to TRAIN; native workers4 and exact iterator replay

native_recipe.planner_scope: TRAIN features and TRAIN labels only, explicit repair
native_recipe.optimizer: original AdamW two groups; no decay for gain/bias parameters
native_recipe.scheduler: original cosine/warmup AFTER each optimizer update, including step0

adaptations: TRAIN-only feature statistics and label proportions; TEST cannot change adaptive plan
standard Bundle replaces CSV/H5 input; identical per-index42 patch selection and padding
absent coordinates use zeros only for unused native loader field; no spatial claim
fixed TEST; serialized best weights and full optimizer/scaler/RNG/sampler recovery
actual original workers4 retained; resume replays deterministic input iteration, never optimizer updates
ordinal endpoint uses classification trainer and explicit kappa selection
torch2.5.1 runtime is a benchmark choice; original environment lists torch2.3.0
native_behaviors_preserved: randperm consumed during TRAIN even when hidden>=input dimension
overlapping deterministic chunk ensemble and ddof1 uncertainty, including one-chunk NaN
fixed per-index42 train crop, full original VAL/TEST bags, native padding mask
AUC low-variance sampler, balanced sampler or dedicated-generator random sampler
original strict-improvement early stopping; metric ties increment patience
original shallow in-memory best-state alias; immutable serialized selection used
